title: Datadog tag policy v1 (observability package)
description: The single tag contract of the observability package: which Datadog tag keys every signal carries, where their values come from, how keys are renamed / aliased for an existing organisation's monitors, and which static tags are added per environment. Rendered by modules/tagging (Terraform) and tools/tags/tag_policy.py (Python) with identical semantics.

tag_key.description: Datadog tag key: starts with a letter, lowercase (Datadog lowercases metric and span tag keys).

required.description: A missing value is a gap (plan precondition when enforce_required, check_coverage exit 1).

source.description: Documentation: where the value comes from.

key.description: Datadog key emitted for this canonical key (rename). env, service and version cannot be renamed (Datadog unified service tagging); use aliases.

aliases.description: Additional Datadog keys that carry the same value (e.g. environment for env).

default.description: Value used when the caller supplies none.

value_map.description: Value normalisation before Datadog normalisation; keys compared lowercase (e.g. development -> dev).

allowed_values.description: When set, other (normalised) values are gaps.

otel_attributes.description: OTel resource attribute names carrying the value (default: [<Datadog key>]).

azure_tag_keys.description: Azure resource tag names that carry the value. The first is written on resources managed by the package; all are mapped to the Datadog key when Azure platform logs carry resource tags.

k8s_label.description: Also emit as a pod label (label-safe values only) mapped with podLabelsAsTags; every value is always in the ad.datadoghq.com/tags annotation.
